text:
marta_sales: Heads-up — MedleyHealth dropped an RFI this morning. Key asks: private deployment option with AZ isolation, BYO-HSM (customer-managed keys), mandatory PHI redaction before any logs leave their subnet OR proof HSM never exposes cleartext. They want a capability matrix + POC plan + rough price by Wed EOD. Can SE/SRE help scope?

lee_se: Can you paste the exact language from the security section and a link to the RFI? Need to know if they accept tokenization or require redaction at source.

marta_sales: Link: https://medleyhealth.example.com/rfi/medley-rfi-2026.pdf. Quote: "All PHI must be redacted prior to egress from customer network unless customer-managed HSM prevents any cleartext being accessible to vendor." They ask for a 3-week POC focused on messaging/attachments and an integration runbook.

ash_sre: For BYO-HSM we support two modes: (1) KMIP proxy where their HSM issues keys we can call via mutual-TLS to unwrap in-VPC, or (2) on-prem appliance with offline model-serving and no external key access. Need their network diagram + QPS/mean tokens to size.

lee_se: Good — we'll present three validated approaches in the matrix: A) client-side redaction/tokenization SDK, B) Private deployment in their VPC with brokered HSM keys (unwrapped only inside their subnet), C) Hybrid: tokenization at edge + envelope encryption to Redwood Private. Put short bullets for tradeoffs (latency, ops, compliance).

toni_finance: Ballpark pricing (draft): POC (3w) fixed $18k, Dedicated starter $7k/mo, Private install one-time $55k + $9k/mo, optional on-prem appliance integration $95k+ depending on travel. Mark as draft.

nina_legal: Note: if they insist on customer-only key custody (no vendor unwrap), we must escalate - that becomes an on-prem deployment and needs separate SOW and support SLA. Also confirm whether Medley accepts our SOC2 + pen-test report; if not, we need to transmit extra artifacts.

lee_se: POC deliverables (short bullets for matrix):
- end-to-end message flow demo with redaction/tokenization
- throughput test at 80 rps using 1.5KB avg payloads
- audit logs showing no cleartext egress for sampled traces
- integration runbook + firewall/VPC peering checklist

ash_sre: I'll add provisioning ETA: 36-72h after network access and peering info. Firewall snippet for their infra team:```
# Allow Redwood Private management/proxy
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <redwood-admin-ip> --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# Allow admin control plane (if needed)
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <redwood-admin-subnet> --dport 10250:10255 -j ACCEPT
```

attachments-bot: uploaded "medley-rfi.pdf" and "capability-matrix-v0.1.xlsx" to thread (internal links).

lee_se: Small SDK example we can drop in the matrix for client-side tokenization:```js
// redact/tokenize before send
const token = tokenizePHI(text);
await sendToApi({payload: token, meta: {hash: sha256(text)}});
```

toni_finance: Quick ask to SE: if we propose the hybrid model, does that materially change monthly pricing? we should call out "encryption service" add-on.

lee_se: Hybrid adds little latency but extra ops - suggest +15% on monthly base for key-proxy management during SLA. I'll flag in matrix.

nina_legal: Also add a row: "Data deletion attestation" with checkbox for POC vs production and required language if they demand certs.

marta_sales: Action items: Lee - update capability matrix with the 3 approaches and POC deliverables by Tue noon. Ash - provide provisioning ETA + firewall snippet + HA notes by EOD. Toni - confirm draft numbers with pricing ops and respond Tue afternoon. Nina - review RFI redaction wording and flag any contract changes. I'll schedule a short sync with Medley security lead Wed 11am ET.

lee_se: On it. I'll wire the first draft matrix and include a short decision guidance row (risk/latency/cost).

ash_sre: On call Wed. I'll bring the network checklist and a small runbook snippet for key rotation + emergency key revoke.

marta_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll follow up after the security sync.
